_comment: MAINTAINED BY HAND. There is no reliable free coordinator table in nflverse, so this file is the source of truth for scheme discontinuity. It exists because the scheme factor blends a team's prior-season tendencies into its current ones -- which is right for a team that kept its staff and badly wrong for one that did not. A team listed for a season has its prior-season scheme prior DISCARDED and is shrunk toward the league average instead, until the current season produces enough charted games to stand on its own.
_comment_maintenance: Update in the offseason, and again if a coordinator is fired mid-season. A stale file fails silently and in the worst direction: it keeps quoting a scheme the team no longer runs, with full confidence. features/scheme.js logs the list size on every run so an empty or forgotten file is visible in the logs.
_comment_scope: off = offensive scheme changed (new HC calling plays, or new OC). def = defensive scheme changed (new DC). A head-coach change usually implies both unless the coordinator was retained.
